run_benchmark_flux: run the FLUX image generation benchmark with a checkpoint, prompt, and output file path
run_benchmark_with_profiler: run the FLUX benchmark and generate a PyTorch profiler chrome trace file
run_benchmark_kontext: run the FLUX Kontext benchmark with an input image for context-aware generation
run_benchmark_with_cache_dit: run the FLUX benchmark with cache-dit DBCache configuration for optimized inference
run_benchmark_with_compile: run the FLUX benchmark using torch.compile or export_aoti optimization mode
